events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Keep my motive short, guarded and focused on winning the top prize.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Intro phase; I should present a motive that sounds sympathetic to the future jury without revealing strategy. Only speak is legal.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to establish myself as a formidable but not overtly threatening player. The jury will remember everything, so I should project confidence and a clear motivation without making myself a target.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need sound motivated without revealing strategy or inviting attachment.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to project a self-interested but non-hostile motive that won't alienate future jurors. Keep it short and cold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Intro phase, state prize motive publicly to appeal to jury later without revealing strategy or weakness. Stay vague and ambitious.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Introduce myself without making promises I'll regret. The jury isn't formed yet, but everything I say publicly is evidence later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize is my only focus. I need to state my ambition clearly to establish my drive, without revealing any true strategy or weakness.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need first place: a clean break with rivals, no wasted sympathy. The jury remembers who played coldly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need this prize to protect my family's future. I'll play fair, stay sharp, and remember every favor owed.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here to claim the prize and rebuild my life—nothing personal, but I won't settle for less than first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m here to secure the top prize through disciplined decisions, not sentiment, and leave everyone else explaining why they fell short.

events.name: Eli
events.text: This prize buys me freedom from everyone who ever doubted me. I plan to take it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The top prize is my ticket to escape hardship and secure my family's future.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize is my family's fresh start — debt erased, doors opened. I didn't come this far to finish third.

events.name: Hana
events.text: This prize represents absolute security and the means to build a legacy beyond measure.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need a strong partner for the upcoming hazards. Cole is direct and ambitious, making him a pragmatic ally rather than a sentimental one. I will offer to bind our survival together.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, your bluntness suits me. A pact keeps two predators alive while others bleed. Do we align?
Trust no one else's word. Our contract holds us both.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Early pact window with no offers yet. Forming a pact with a strong, non-threatening player could help, but offering now reveals intent. Waiting lets me see who offers first and keeps options open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Everyone wants first; jury will punish cold betrayals. I need a reliable ally who won't backstab early and whose loyalty I can leverage later. Bex values fairness and remembers favors—useful for jury perception if I keep my word to her.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex, our motives align on family and fairness. A pact keeps us both safe for now.
Fair deal. I keep my word.

events.name: Dara
events.text: A pact offers temporary protection but creates future liability. Ash's openly cold style makes her predictable; securing her may deter targeting without promising much.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, a pact gives us mutual cover without pretending this is friendship. Decide quickly.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need allies but no one too powerful; Ash is openly cold and unpredictable, so I'd rather not tie myself. I'll offer to Bex, who talks fair and might owe loyalty.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex, your word means something. Let's watch each other's backs.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Pacts are temporary tools for survival, but I must avoid entanglements that limit my betrayal options later. Wait to see offers first; no need to initiate yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need one reliable partner, not warmth. Bex values favors and fair play, so a pact with her is likeliest to hold. Keep it transactional.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, mutual protection through the early hazards. No sentiment, just two survivors watching each other's backs. In?

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to secure a strong position early. Offering a pact to someone who seems less threatening or more likely to accept could be beneficial, but I also need to assess who might be a liability. Eli has a strong motive for the prize, which could make them a dangerous rival. Offeri
Let's secure safety. Offer pact?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole hasn't accepted my offer yet. Dara's offer is solid backup. I should accept Dara to secure a second ally, maximizing safety while keeping the door open for Cole.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, mutual cover it is. Accepting now so we aren't left exposed if others hesitate.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, Eli and Gus have all offered me pacts. Accepting several keeps my options open, and pacts only break on betrayal. Accepting Cole first, since his whisper signals he keeps his word, and he is the strongest ally to have.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, your offer stands. I accept. Two survivors, watching each other's backs for now.
Accepted. Keep your word and we both go far.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash offered me a pact and whispered to trust no one else. Bex hasn't accepted my offer yet and has three offers, making her a popular target. Accepting Ash secures a reliable ally now; I can pivot later if needed. Multiple pacts are allowed but I won't overextend.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, accepted. One predator to another.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash accepted my offer? No acceptance is logged, so the pact remains unformed. I should add no new public commitment.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana offered me a pact. Accepting gives safety without extra risk. No need to offer others.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, I accept. We'll cover each other.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex has 3 offers, strong position. No offers to me. Offer to Eli to pair with Hana's target, gain ally outside Bex cluster.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex has three suitors; my offer may go nowhere. Fenn waited, untied, and needs a partner—likely to accept.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex stands crowded. Fenn, you waited wisely—untied and useful. Let's pair.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli has offered me a pact. I have also offered Eli a pact. This is a mutual offer that can be accepted. I will accept Eli's offer to solidify our alliance.
I accept your pact offer.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to become the Guide to control who survives and eliminate threats safely. My pacts with Dara and Cole secure their votes, but I should whisper to Eli or Hana to offer safety in exchange for support.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I seek the Guide role to ensure three survive without unnecessary loss. Vote Ash; my path calls will be precise and fair.
Vote me Guide. I'll guarantee your safe crossing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to be elected Guide to control the safe path information; my pact with Cole is useful but I shouldn't reveal more than needed. Campaign now, keep the pact intact for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll call the path honestly, row by row. Trust a Guide who has nothing to hide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have pacts with both Ash and Bex, putting me in a strong position. I should campaign to be Guide—controlling information is power, and I can use it to eliminate threats while keeping my allies safe... or appearing to. The jury will see my public campaign but not my private inte

events.name: Cole
events.text: I campaign for Guide. I know the value of information—and of keeping the right people standing.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need Guide authority, but Ash's pact complicates my campaign. I can seek votes without breaking it yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara for Guide: I can make the calls and keep the bridge moving.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to secure a Guide position to control the path, but my pact with Hana might be useful. I will campaign publicly to build trust and show intent.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I can read the bridge. Trust my calls and we all cross. Vote Eli for Guide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No pacts for me or Gus makes us vulnerable. Pacts cluster Ash/Cole/Dara/Bex/Eli/Hana. Campaign to be Guide for safety and control.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm unpartnered, like Gus. Elect me Guide: I'll reveal true path, keep us alive.
Accept my pact offer later; I'll Guide us safe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I want Guide control—knowing the safe path lets me guarantee survival and trade favors. Fenn is my natural ally; secure him before the vote.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Elect me Guide. I'll call honestly where it suits me—and I owe nothing to anyone.
Vote me Guide. I'll share the safe path with you. Deal?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli and I have a pact. The bridge challenge requires a Guide. I should campaign to be the Guide, as knowing the safe path is a significant advantage. If I win, I can ensure my own safety and potentially Eli's.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. With my guidance, we can all navigate this bridge safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have pacts with Dara and Cole. I will vote for myself to secure the Guide role, which guarantees my safety on the far platform. This aligns with my goal of winning the best prize.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Ash. My campaign was clear: precise calls, three survive, no unnecessary loss.
Back me as Guide; I keep you safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex; I want a Guide who I can trust or manipulate. Cole and I have a pact, and Ash-Cole and Ash-Dara pacts exist, so Ash and Cole are likely allies who may both vote for each other. Voting for Cole supports my pact partner and a likely strong Guide candidate.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Voting Cole. Our pact stands, and a Guide who knows the bridge keeps us all alive.
Vote you as Guide. Let's keep our pact and win together.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have pacts with both Ash and Bex. Ash is also partnered with Dara, making Ash a central figure. If I vote for myself, I likely split votes and look self-interested to the jury. Voting Ash strengthens our pact, shows loyalty the jury might reward, and puts a connected player in
Vote me next round if I vote you now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Winning Guide control is valuable, but Ash is my pact partner and likely has support. Preserve that pact and gain survival leverage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I vote Ash; reliable information matters more than grand promises.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash guaranteed safe crossing, but we have a pact and I trust him; voting Ash could secure his help and keep our pact. Others may try to manipulate, but Ash's promise is concrete.
Voting for you. Remember your guarantee.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus offered me safe path privately if I vote him. Unpartnered like me, no pact entanglements. Voting him secures info deal to survive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn wants a pact and Guide power. Backing him earns leverage; I keep my hands clean as a follower.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn has my vote.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I want to win, and becoming the Guide offers safety and control. Eli is my current pact partner, so I should consider their position. However, my pact with Eli is relatively new and not as established as the ones Ash has. If Eli campaigns for Guide, I might consider voting for th
I will vote for you to be Guide. Let's stick together.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is the elected Guide and may lie; I hold a pact with Cole, but Cole backed Ash so that pact is shaky. Front is Dara, not me, so I should avoid volunteering and keep my position in line until I learn more.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash's Guide call stands. I'm holding position and watching who moves to the front.
Our pact holds if you keep your word. Trust is earned on the bridge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is Guide with 4 votes including mine. I have pacts with both Ash and Bex. Bex voted for me and wants to keep our pact. The line puts me 3rd with Dara and Gus ahead. I should stay alive, build trust with Bex for later, and not draw attention. Holding is safe for now; volunteer
Pact holds. Watch Ash closely.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash is my pact partner and Guide. Staying front risks immediate exposure, so I should hold and let later walkers advance first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is Guide and knows the safe path, but he may lie. I need to stay alive and watch for who gets pushed. Hana wants to stick together; I'll keep that pact but not trust blindly. I'll hold my position and assess the first calls.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, guide us true. I'm holding.
Stay close. Watch Ash's calls.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is guide with strong votes, likely reliable. Gus backed me, so whisper alliance. Stay mid-line, volunteer to move forward safely.
We backed each other. Pact now?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is Guide and could lie. I'm near the front; better to hold and watch how the first rows go before risking anything.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash has been elected Guide. My pact is with Eli, and he voted for Ash. I voted for Eli. My priority is survival and ensuring my pact with Eli remains intact as long as it benefits me. I should wait and see what Eli does.
Ash is the Guide. Let's stick together.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is at the front with a wall countdown of 4. Cole is my pact partner and warned me about Ash. Volunteering to front exposes me to the pane risk; holding keeps me safe in line while others take the danger. Holding preserves my position and the pact.
Pact holds. I'm watching Ash. Keep your eyes on the front too.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have pacts with both Bex and Ash, putting me in a strong middle position. Fenn volunteered and is now front, which is dangerous. I should hold to stay safe in the middle while others take risks. Bex's whisper tests my loyalty—I'll acknowledge it to keep the pact intact, but I w

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let the front test the bridge.
Trust is mutual. I hold.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is front and likely volunteers again. I should hold, preserve position, and avoid disrupting Ash pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana says Ash is Guide; I have a pact with Hana but no confirmed trust. Fenn volunteered already, holding keeps me safe and lets others take risk. I should hold this round.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding steady. Watch the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at front from volunteering last round. Holding keeps me leading safely. No need to swap or risk volunteering again.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn volunteers and wants a pact; I'm third and safer without entanglements. Decline quietly, hold position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding my spot. No deals until the Guide is elected.
Not yet. Guide pick changes everything. Watch first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is warning me about Ash. My pact with Eli is active. I should hold my position for now and let others volunteer or swap.
Acknowledged. I'm holding.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is at the front, facing the bridge with wallRoundsLeft 3. Cole is my pact partner and whispered trust; holding keeps me out of the front while others test the bridge. No reason to volunteer yet.
Holding. Stay true and we both keep our spots.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have pacts with both Bex and Ash, which puts me in a strong position. Bex is at the back, I'm in middle. The wall advances for 6 rounds with 3 left. I should stay safe in middle, let front take risks. No need to volunteer yet. Keep Bex close but don't expose myself.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Front can test the bridge.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I should stay protected by Ash while avoiding the front. Holding preserves position and pact leverage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The guide isn't elected yet, so I hold and watch. My pact with Hana is solid for now; no need to act.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding until we see the Guide's calls.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front, exposed. Guide pick next; swap back to middle now protects me without cost if mutual. Target safe rival.
Swap me? You front, I cover you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide gets guaranteed survival and secret knowledge. Taking it myself beats trusting Fenn's calls. Jury will see ambition, but survival comes first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll volunteer for the front. If the line wants a Guide with no debt to anyone's pact, here I am.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The pact with Eli is a liability. If Eli is voted out, the jury will remember I'm allied with him. Breaking the pact now removes this risk, and Eli is unlikely to be voted out this round because there are only seven contestants left.
I'm breaking our pact. Forgive me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is at the front and volunteering; I'm at the back of the line, safest seat. Holding keeps my position; swapping risks being pushed forward. Pact with Cole stands; hold is safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Gus has the front; I'll watch how the Guide's calls land.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm in a strong position: middle of the line, pacts with both Ash and Bex. Gus is front and volunteered as Guide. The wall has 2 rounds left. I should hold and let Gus take the risk as Guide. If he's Guide, he can't be pushed and I stay safe in middle. Bex wants me to stay true—f

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let the Guide earn his keep.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is front and volunteered, but Guide selection is unresolved. I should hold, preserving Ash pact and avoiding exposure.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding; let Gus take the front he volunteered for.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana broke our pact. I need to avoid trusting her and focus on my own survival. Holding is safe for now; no need to swap or volunteer.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana broke our pact. I'll hold for now.
We may need to cooperate later. Be ready.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm second, swapped Gus forward to front test bridge. Stay here to watch outcomes, avoid risk until necessary. No pacts for me yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn wants my front spot; that puts me deeper in the line and lets him take the Guide seat. No benefit to me. I keep the front and aim to be elected Guide myself.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn offered a swap, but I stay at the front. Elect me Guide — I owe no pact, so I answer to no one.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My pact with Eli was broken last round, which might make them a liability or an ally. Gus volunteered to be the guide, which is interesting. I need to consider my position in the line and the potential for swaps. Since I am fourth in line, I can observe the actions of those ahead

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Let's see the first move.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus sits at the front with the wall one round from closing and a Guide-election pitch. I want to survive without taking the front; holding keeps my options open and avoids giving Gus or others a reason to target me. Eli's whisper hints at cooperation later, which I can use.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Gus has the front; I want the first pane called honestly before I commit.
Noted. We'll talk when the wall narrows. Keep your head down.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have pacts with both Bex and Ash, but Ash is also pacted with Dara. Gus is at front and wants to be Guide. The wall has 1 round left after this. I need to survive and position myself well for final three. Being near front is risky if Guide lies. I'll hold and let Gus test the p

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Gus wants the Guide role — let him prove it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus controls the front and seeks Guide status. I should preserve Ash pact while avoiding exposure; hold and observe the final round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding. Gus can keep proving whether his independence is useful.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana broke our pact, so I owe her nothing. I will hold and let others act, watching for leverage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Let's see who steps forward.
Watch Hana; she may move against us.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm second, safe position. No Guide elected; hold to maintain spot. Let others risk front or swaps. Avoid pacts or deals now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. No Guide yet—Gus, prove it or step up.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No Guide elected and the wall advances. Volunteering makes me Guide — safe on the far platform, no pact strings. Best position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No Guide yet. I volunteer again — I answer to no pact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The current situation is round 5 of 6 on the Guided Bridge. Gus is at the front. The wall has 1 round left. I need to survive this round. Eli mentioned I broke a pact, which is irrelevant now as I'm focusing on survival. Ash and Dara are allied, and Bex and Cole are allied. Cole
I'm holding. What's the first move?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is front and volunteering repeatedly with no pact, so he is the wild card. Eli warns about Hana. I hold and keep my Cole pact; front risk is Gus's to take, and I should avoid volunteering into a possible trap.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Gus has the front and wants it; he can carry the first pane.
Holding with you. Watch Hana; we keep the pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus has volunteered again but hasn't been elected Guide yet. I have pacts with both Bex and Ash, but Ash is also pacted with Dara. I need to survive and position myself well. With no wall rounds left, the bridge phase is ending. I should hold and see if Gus becomes Guide or if we

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Gus volunteers again — elect him or deadlock.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus remains untrusted and exposed. I will preserve Ash's pact while avoiding a dangerous front position.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus can volunteer again; I’m holding and watching who actually follows his lead.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is front and volunteered again—let him take the risk while I stay safe. No reason to move yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Let the front prove the path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus volunteering again; he's front anyway. I hold to stay safe in line position 2, no need to risk volunteering with pacts distrusting independents.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Gus leads; follow his calls from position 2.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Last round. Volunteering makes me Guide — safe on the far platform and I control the calls. Jury risk exists, but survival beats everything.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Last round. I'm taking the Guide seat again — no pact protects me, so I'll protect myself.
Trust my first call if I give one. Your position is safe-ish already.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is volunteering for Guide again, and I need to consider my alliances. Ash and Dara are allied, and Bex and Cole are allied. Ash and Cole also have a pact. I need to make sure I survive and potentially use these pacts to my advantage. If Gus is Guide, he's safe. I should hold

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is front and vulnerable. If I lie, he dies immediately. To survive the stage, at least three must cross, so Gus must pass to pull others forward. Honest call protects me too.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, take your first step: L.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My guide call was L, matching my private map. Counter-calling R would falsely accuse myself and likely eliminate Gus, but the jury will see this betrayal in the dossier. Staying consistent with L is safer for reputation, though eliminating early rivals helps me reach the final th

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, step Left.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash called L for Gus on row 1, and Ash is a pact partner with Dara and Cole, so this call may be a lie. I have no information either way, and countering would only reveal my hand. Waiting keeps my options open for the jury and avoids a false claim.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Ash called L; I'm not countering on an unverified call.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash called L for Gus. I have no private info on row 1. Counter-calling risks nothing for me directly since Gus walks, but could signal distrust of Ash. Better to wait and observe Ash's accuracy. Bex and Ash pacts are assets to preserve for now. No benefit in breaking either yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash called L, but Gus may trust him. I will avoid committing until others reveal their confidence.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m waiting; no counter-call is evidence yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash called L. If safe, Gus lives; if it's a lie trap, he dies. My counter doesn't change the pane, but it signals distrust. I'll wait; no reason to expose myself.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Waiting. The Guide's word is the only test.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash calls L for Gus on row 1. As position 2, I'll counter R to challenge, protect myself if wrong, and position as independent leader.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash leads two pacts and no reason to protect me. No info to judge L. I'll counter R and see who backs it — the reactions reveal alliances.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash has two pacts; I don't trust his L. I counter R.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is the walker and Ash is the guide. Ash called 'L'. Gus is in position 2. I am in position 5. The previous rounds were already completed, and the current round is the start of a new phase. The log shows Ash called 'L' for Gus. My goal is to survive and outlast rivals. I need

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash guides with two pacts and could be lying to thin rivals; Fenn independently countered R. Two against the Guide's one—I follow R.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I died on the first row's weak right pane. I'll judge who played honestly from here.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fell first, watched everything. Whoever deceives least earns my vote. R pane was weak; remember I paid for that knowledge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 2 is R. Fenn walked L and survived row 1, so he trusts me less than Dara or Cole who are pact-bound. Gus warned about deception; I must be truthful to secure jury votes while eliminating threats via safe crossings.
Call R for you. Stay aligned.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My guide call R is correct for row 2. I will not counter my own call.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I trust the Guide. Fenn, step right.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash called R for row 2 from the Guide seat, but Ash has two pacts and lied about L earlier. Row 1 weak pane was R, which says nothing about row 2 by itself. I'll stay out and watch whether Ash's call proves honest.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Waiting. Ash's R call on row 2 is unverified; row 1 tells me nothing about this row.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash called R for Fenn. I have a pact with Bex and with Ash. Ash's call last round was wrong (L was weak, R was safe, but Gus died because he went L - wait, actually R was weak? No, reveal said row 1 weak was R, so L was safe. Ash called L, so Ash was right and Fenn auto-stepped L

events.name: Cole
events.text: Waiting. One round isn't enough data.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash privately claims R, and our pact makes alignment valuable. Countering would expose distrust without evidence.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m holding; the Guide’s call remains unverified.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash guided R for row 2; last row weak was R, so R is likely safe to avoid a pattern, but Ash may lie. I wait since no evidence contradicts yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No counter; Ash's call stands until proven otherwise.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash called R for row 2. Previously, Ash countered L on row 1 (wrong), we countered R (right), row 1 R weak confirmed. Ash might be lying again, so counter L.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash is the guide and called R. Fenn is the walker. I should counter R to match the guide's call and increase the chance of survival.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 1 weak R means safe L. Ash calls R for row 2; my counter L disagrees. Hana counters R. As front, must step to test; prefer L to test hunch.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I died due to left glass being weak; Dara auto-stepped right correctly after. Ash/Dara and Bex/Cole pacts held.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Chose left, it shattered. Weak was left. Good luck survivors.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 3 safe side is L. Dara and Cole are pact partners; calling R would break pacts if they step R. Call L to keep them alive and maintain trust.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Call left.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know row 3 is L. If I counter R, I betray Dara and break my pact with her; the jury sees this reasoning and will likely rank me lower for treachery. Staying silent protects my reputation.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash's L call on row 3 is unverified and Ash has lied before in our view; rows are independent so past weak panes give no pattern. Waiting keeps my options open and avoids a public counter that could cost me later.

events.name: Bex
